pages.text: TFE changes to existing TFC systems are documented directly in their standard TFC Field Guide chapters. This entry only provides navigation so that rules and values are not duplicated and allowed to drift apart.

pages.title: Crops and Wild Plants
pages.text: $(l:mechanics/crops)Crops$(): cultivation mechanics plus temperature, hydration, and nutrient needs for all 29 crops.$(br2)$(l:the_world/wild_crops)Wild Crops$(): natural generation temperatures and rainfall, ordered from cold to warm.$(br2)$(l:the_world/wild_fruits#fruit_trees)Fruit Trees$(): natural generation, growth, and fruiting conditions.$(br2)$(l:the_world/wild_fruits#tall_bushes)Tall Bushes$() / $(l:the_world/wild_fruits#small_bushes)Small Bushes$(): generation and growth conditions for berry bushes.

pages.title: Prospecting
pages.text: $(l:mechanics/prospecting)Prospecting$(): propick material tiers, scan ranges, multiple mineral results, and HUD display rules.
